Definition: A Structured Domain Outline partitioned into flat Categories and Knowledge Types with retrieval-driven scope ratification and coverage verification.
The normalized, decomposed representation of the domain as expressed by the handbook sources.
A flat partition of IN-scope Handbook Units with no nesting, overlaps, or gaps.
A discrete, reusable kind of knowledge object within a Category.
A specific domain topic within a Knowledge Type and the decomposition unit below Type.

Definition: An atomic instruction or concept extracted from sources and used for coverage checking.
A dual citation with a Markdown line anchor and an HTML anchor.
sha1(UnitStatement)[:12], used for deduplication, retrieval freshness, and HTML review keys.
A per-source TOC tree capturing section hierarchy, line ranges, asset IDs, and inline reference labels.
A per-source slice of roughly 15k MD tokens that respects section boundaries.
An ordered list of dispatch units for one source.

Synonyms: per-source HTML; source HTML review surface
Definition: A per-source review surface generated by render_source_html.py for structure, atom-review, or coverage-review modes.
Sibling HTML surfaces under a source audit folder, one per asset kind.
Timestamped verified or flagged browser exports consumed by later renders.
A table enumerating all Handbook Units with stable IDs and explicit mappings.
A deterministic Phase 3 prior listing source TOC trees and section-pair keyword-overlap alignment.
A summary of counts and gaps that makes decomposition quality measurable and comparable.
A section listing every companion register with filename, package role, and description.
A companion file that holds authoritative heavy machine-truth for the package.
A single-file monolithic render that is not the authoritative amendment surface.
Extraction reproducibility prefilter that independently re-extracts pages before human review.
A TASK skill used for independent page re-extraction from page raster input.
A Gate 1.5-P sidecar carrying prose hunks, equation proposals, asset structural fails, caption notes, and summaries.
A sidecar populated with surviving machine or Phase 3 equation correction proposals.
A companion register recording per-Category retrieval-driven scope verdicts.
A companion register recording per-atom misassignment candidates.
A companion register recording per-Knowledge Type retrieval-driven scope verdicts.
A bounded table for niche, novel, or ambiguous terms and their synonyms.
An attested zero-AU state for sections or knowledge surfaces that will be populated later by source-driven scope-change cycles.
Category notes citing source sections that motivate the category, including agreement, divergence, or supersession.

Synonyms: source catalog snapshot; V2 source database
Definition: A domain-local source catalog snapshot built under _LocalIndexes/ from sources, sidecars, section nodes, and decomposition CSVs.
BM25 and dense retrieval sidecars built from the current source database snapshot.
Verdict for high retrieval overlap and mapped-atom similarity at or above threshold.

Blocking verdict when mapped atoms span topics not covered by the declared scope.
Advisory verdict for low pairwise similarity that does not block gate closure.
A best-effort schema assigned to a Knowledge Type, with TBD allowed.
A small record of non-trivial choices and policy-level decisions for traceability.
A list of unresolved items referenced by stable IDs.
